svg.title: From negative filtering to probe occurrences
svg.desc: An enabled Bloom filter rejects a queried zero and sends passes to exact lookup. A 31/1/32-bit dictionary value locates a k-mer in a segment. A separate table stores a single probe occurrence inline or points to multiple occurrences. Schematic examples.
svg.title: From negative filtering to probe occurrences
